matches.description:
About Bitstack 
 It all started with an idea in 2021. Initially built to democratize Bitcoin in France, Bitstack has gone from a simple product that invests spare change in bitcoin, to a crypto-native bank bringing a better way to save, spend, and grow money to our 300K+ users. We want to rebuild finance from the ground up to empower people to achieve financial freedom by participating in a more open and inclusive financial system. We’re a small, ambitious team of operators. We believe in moving fast, sweating the details, and creating products people truly love. At Bitstack, you’ll have the opportunity to shape not just our products, but the culture and practices of our entire organization. Bitstack is backed by YC, leading VCs like 13books Capital, Stillmark, Serena, and many more. We are building a product our users love and we are just getting started!

 The Role 
 Bitstack runs dozens of interconnected backend services on Google Cloud. As the engineering team grows, we want every engineer to be able to test their changes end to end, quickly and independently, before they reach our shared environments.
 As part of the Infrastructure team, you will build a local test environment for our backend engineers and QA. The goal is simple: anyone can start our backend services and their dependencies on their own machine with a single command, reproduce real business scenarios and test asynchronous flows end to end. You will own the project from the initial assessment through to company-wide adoption.

 What You'll Be Doing 
 1. Assessment & Recommendation 
 Learn our stack (Go and Python services, Bazel, Docker, Kubernetes, GCP) and map how our services depend on each other.

 Evaluate the test tooling and emulators already in our codebase, as well as the tools available on the market.

 Recommend an approach, and record your tooling choices and trade-offs in a decision log.

 2. Building the Local Environment 
 Start with a pilot cluster of interconnected services and get it running locally with a single command.

 Solve the real problems as they come up: configuration and secrets, service-to-service authentication, cloud dependencies (Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, databases, caches) and async workers.

 Extend coverage cluster by cluster until every backend service is included.

 3. Scenarios, Data & Adoption 
 Build seed data and scripts so that any user state, limit or time-based event can be reproduced and reset on demand.

 Work with backend engineers and QA as your first users, gather their feedback and fix what breaks.

 Write documentation clear enough for a new engineer to get set up on their own, and support the team through the switchover.

 By the end of the internship, you will turn your decision log into a recommendation report and hand over a tool the team will keep maintaining.
 You will gain hands-on experience with a production-grade microservices architecture on Google Cloud, and see how a platform tool is designed, built and adopted by an engineering team. You will learn how infrastructure decisions are made and documented, and work closely with backend, QA and infrastructure engineers, with mentoring from a DevOps engineer throughout.

 What We're Looking For 
 Currently in the final year of an engineering school or Master’s degree (Bac+5) in Computer Science or a related field, and looking for a 6-month end-of-studies internship starting in early 2027.

 Hands-on experience with Docker and a working knowledge of Kubernetes.

 Comfortable with Linux and scripting (shell, Python or similar).

 Previous experience with a cloud provider, through an internship, a project or coursework. GCP is a plus.

 Experience with Go, Bazel or Docker Compose is a plus, but not required.

 Curious and autonomous: you like to understand how a system fits together before changing it.

 Able to explain technical trade-offs clearly, in writing and to the engineers who will use what you build.

 Fluent in English. French is a plus.

 Based in Paris or happy to relocate for the internship. Exceptional candidates elsewhere in France who’d prefer to work remotely are welcome to apply too.

 Perks & Benefits 
 💻 3 days in the office in Paris (Bourse) and 2 days working remotely
 🕑 Flexible working hours
 🏄Team activities and annual offsites
 🍉 Swile meal vouchers

 Diversity & Inclusion 
 We hire talented and passionate people from all kinds of backgrounds, we don’t care about your age or where you studied. If you’re excited about the role but your past experience doesn’t match every bullet point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. What matters most is that you’re a builder at heart, you share our values, and you’re enthusiastic about our mission.

matches.title: Fullstack Consultant

 All die Klischees von Beratungen findest Du bei uns nicht – es gibt keine Anzugspflicht (bitte hab aber zumindest Klamotten an ;)), keine 50- oder 60-Stunden Wochen und kein Einstiegsgehalt für den großen Namen. Was Du aber bei uns findest: die besten Partys und Veranstaltungen!
 Hard facts zu uns: Als Unternehmensberatung liegt unser Schwerpunkt uns auf dem IT-Entwicklungs- und dazugehörigen Business Bereich. Wir decken die komplette Softwareentwicklung mit Fokus auf das moderne Java-Ökosystem ab (Backend, Frontend, Fullstack, DevOps, Architektur und QA). In den IT-nahen Business Rollen finden bei uns Product Owner, Scrum Master, technische Projektleiter, Business Analysten und auch PMO ihr berufliches Zuhause. Aktuell zählen wir knapp 250 liebe Kollegen, die tagtäglich unsere über 40 aktiven Kunden in unterschiedlichen Industrien auf ihren Projekten unterstützen.
 Aufgaben
 Als Consultant bringst Du Hands-on Deine Expertise direkt im Projekt ein und haust so alle aus den Socken. Niemand ist so wie DU!
 Du zauberst mit Java (17+), Spring Boot und Microservices die coolsten Anwendungen aus dem Code-Hut.
 Du bist Meister des CI/CD-Universums und sorgst dafür, dass Anwendungen mit Lichtgeschwindigkeit ins Rampenlicht katapultiert werden.
 Mit Docker und Kubernetes jonglierst Du virtuose Containerstücke und beeindruckst mit Performance, die uns umhaut.
 Cloud-Plattformen wie AWS oder Azure sind Deine Spielwiesen, auf denen Du die Wolken beherrschst und Anwendungen in luftige Höhen hebst.
 Bei der Frontend-Magie bist Du der Superstar und kreierst mit Angular, React, und/oder vue.js beeindruckende interaktive und reaktionsfähige Benutzeroberflächen, die den Nutzer zum Staunen bringen.
 Qualifikation
 Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Fullstack-Development.
 Erfahrung in Java (17+), Spring Boot und Microservices.
 Kenntnisse in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes und Cloud-Plattformen (AWS oder Azure).
 Frontend-Expertise mit Angular, React oder vue.js.
 Erfahrung mit TDD und Pair-Programming.
 Abgeschlossenes IT-Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
 Spaß am Berater-Business und Kundenkontakt.
 Zielorientiert, strukturiert, eigenständig und lösungsorientiert.
 Kommunikationsstark, dienstleistungsorientiert und teamfähig.
 Mindestens Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch.
 Benefits
 Neben spannenden Aufgaben, einem stabilen Umfeld sowie einem herzlichen Team bieten wir Dir weitere Vorteile:
 Work-Life-Balance: nicht nur ein Buzzword, sondern gelebt durch Remote-Work, 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und Workation.

matches.description:
Dans le cadre de son développement, OUIDOU CONSULTING recherche plusieurs Ingénieurs en développement JAVA JEE dans le cadre d’un contrat à durée indéterminée.
 Ils/Elles interviendront sur différents projets de développement nécessitant expérience, compétences et intérêts en conception technique et fonctionnelle d’applications web et/ou de gestion.
 Au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire, Ils/Elles participeront à la mise en œuvre d’applications (depuis la conception jusqu’à la livraison), à la maintenance d’applications (TMA) et à la création de projets. Selon les niveaux, chacun(e) pourra trouver sa place siur les sujets pour lesquels il/elle est le plus à l’aise.
 Cela concerne les différentes étapes de réalisation d’une application depuis les développements à l’intégration de modules dans un système d’information cible.
 Les missions ciblées :

 Participation en lien avec la Production et le Chef de Projet à la définition de l’architecture technique et fonctionnelle d’une application;

 Participation avec le chef de projet à l’évaluation des charges et à la planification des développements;

 Réalisation et intégration des différents modules d’une application;

 Participation en lien avec la Production et le chef de projet à l’automatisation des procédures de gestion et des interfaces;

 Réalisation des tests unitaires et participation aux recettes des livrables;

 Prise en charge des maintenances correctives et évolutives des modules ou applications ;

 Activités complémentaires :

 Veille technologique

 Meet-up technologique

 Projet personnel

 ​​​​​​Profil recherché :

 Formation supérieure (Bac+5) en informatique

 Au moins deux années d’expérience dans une équipe de développement en environnement WEB.

 Capacité à s'adapter à un public varié

 Excellent relationnel et d’un réel sens du service.

 Méthode, rigueur et organisation.

 Fondée en 2017 par 3 ingénieurs, partageant les valeurs d’expertise, d’engagement et de proximité, Ouidou est une Entreprise de Services du Numérique en pleine croissance et regroupant 170 collaborateurs.
 Ouidou s’engage à la réussite des projets de ses clients en les accompagnant dans la réflexion et la mise en place de solutions fiables, efficaces et évolutives adaptées aux besoins de l’entreprise.
 Ses domaines d’intervention sont le développement sur de nombreuses technos (JAVA, .NET, Angular, React…), le BigData, le Web, le DevOps, la Mobilité, la sécurité,…., mais aussi l’accompagnement AGILE autour des outils Atlassian et de monday.com, ainsi que sur l’expérience utilisateur avec une expertise UX/UI design.
 Travailler chez Ouidou c’est s’ouvrir de nouveaux horizons, aborder des projets novateurs et exigeants, développer ses compétences et devenir très vite autonome.
 Notre management de proximité favorise l’expression des idées, la collaboration et s’engage au développement des collaborateurs dans une ambiance chaleureuse et conviviale : afterworks, hackatons, meet-ups, évènements d’équipe / d’entreprise...
 Le groupe Ouidou est présent à Paris, Lyon, Nantes, Strasbourg et Lille.

matches.description:
Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)
 Start Date: ASAP
 Languages: English
 Team: Engineering

 About the Role
 Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.
 We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.
 This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.
 This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

 What You'll Do
 Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

 Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

 Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

 Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

 Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

 Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

 What We're Looking For
 Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

 Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

 Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

 An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

 High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

 Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

 Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

 Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

 Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

 Why This Role Matters for You
 Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

 Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

 From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

 Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

 San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.
